This AoI seeks commercial solutions that meet the objectives detailed in Sections 1.2 and 1.3 below. In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) 212.70, the term innovative is defined as any technology, process, or method, including research and development, that is new as of the date of proposal submission, or any new application of an existing technology, process, or method as of the proposal date. CSOs may only be used to obtain innovative solutions or potential capabilities that fulfill requirements; to close capability gaps or provide potential innovative technological advancements; and when meaningful proposals with varying technical or scientific approaches can be reasonably anticipated. ACC-DTA is not obliged to extend a request for proposal or make an award because of this CSO AoI; all awards are subject to the availability of funds and successful negotiations. The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1, "Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements." Competition is lacking because this transitional phase requires highly specialized systems integration, database engineering, and business process reengineering (BPR) services that cannot be unbundled from the active operational sustainment of the legacy GCSS-MC environment. Over its lifecycle, the legacy GCSS-MC E-Business Suite (EBS) architecture has undergone non-standard, extensive customization, resulting in a tightly coupled, bespoke data schema that deviates from commercial baselines. The incumbent systems integrator possesses exclusive institutional knowledge of these system-specific idiosyncrasies, ongoing API integrations, and no

se system-specific idiosyncrasies, ongoing API integrations, and non-standard data tables. Onboarding a new vendor to perform these critical services during the sunset window of the legacy platform would inject unacceptable schedule delays (estimated at 12 to 18 months) to account for procurement lead time, contractor transition, and reverse-engineering of the legacy codebase. Under RFO 6.103-1(c)(2)(ii), such delays would directly compromise total unit readiness across the operating forces, degrade the entire GCSS-MC logistics enterprise, and disrupt the transition to the future Logistics Chain Management System (LCMS). (viii) Qualification Requirements There are no pre-established, formal qualification requirements (per RFO Part 9) that an offeror or its service must meet to be eligible for award. However, any interested source must demonstrate immediate, expert-level capability to sustain the highly customized GCSS-MC EBS environment and execute complex database cleansing and extraction without causing operational downtime. This mode allows the user to gain exclusive access to the radar, i.e. lock the configura- tion parameters for sole use. Three values can be chosen; ‘Disabled’, Optional’ or ‘Mandatory’. If the parameter is set to ‘Mandatory’, the user must request master control mode before being able to change configuration parameters. 3.12.4 Secure protocol Parameter Control Data protocols newer than v. 2.0 and all TRACK Control Data protocols can be secured by a certificate. For each of these protocols, the user may specify whether the protocol should be secured by the certificate, by enabling “Secure Protocol Extensions”. These extensions provide encrypted, authenticated wrappers of the corresponding protocols of the SCANTER Transceiver. Encryption and authentication are based on industry-standard X.509 client/server certificates and TLS version 1.2. 3.12.5 User authentication The Transceiver Control Interface protocol supports Secure Protocol Extensions for encrypted, authenticated access, which means that no third party can gain access without the suitable certificate, which is generated and uploaded

For each rota- tion the encoder sends a number of azimuth count pulses (ACPs), typically 8192 pulses and one azimuth reference pulse (ARP). The encoder is included in a encoder assembly which nor- mally holds one or two encoders. Extractor The extractor analyzes the incoming video for plot cre- ation. Furthermore, it calculates plot properties such as area, intensity, centre of gravity etc. Frequency diversity Frequency diversity (FD) is a sequential transmission on two different frequencies which after processing increas- es the signal quality by an increase of the signal-to-noise ratio. The target is hit twice and behaves differently depending upon the frequency of the electromagnetic wave hitting it. Furthermore, if linear array antennas are used, an additional advantage is achieved, namely the time diversity. Lack Lack is a number counting unsuccessful consecutive updates of a track. Log Compression In this process, the signal is converted from a 26 bit float- ing point signal into an 8-bit logarithmic signal. Mixer A function of the mixer is to convert frequencies, either up or down. The ideal mixer performs the mathematical mul- tiplication of two input signals. It creates signal compo- nents positioned at frequencies equal to the sum and difference of the input signals. For ideal performance, the mixing device must be perfect- ly linear and there must be no leakage of the input signals to the output port. Typically, either the sum, or the differ- ence frequency is removed with a filter. The term Double Balanced Mixer is used to imply neither of the input terms will appear at the mixer output. Les missions de l’Agence de la biomédecine L’Agence de la biomédecine contribue, par l’encadrement, le contrôle, l’évaluation et l’expertise, au respect des règles de sécurité sanitaire et à l’amélioration de la transparence des activités médicales et biologiques relevant de sa compétence. Elle participe à l’élaboration, l’évolution et l’application de la réglementation de ces activités, en lien avec les services de l’Etat, l’Assurance maladie, les professionnels de santé et les parties prenantes. Après la publication des textes réglementaires, elle met en œuvre les nouvelles dispositions et accompagne les professionnels de santé dans leur application. En matière d’évaluation, elle analyse les résultats des activités pour mesurer leur efficacité et concourir à l’évolution des pratiques. Dans chaque domaine d’activité, la loi lui attribue des missions spécifiques. ng zur Eignung“ (IV 124 F) sind vollständig ausgefüllt einzureichen. Sofern ein Unternehmen den Auftrag nicht alleine ausführen kann, d. h. eine Bewerber­/Bietergemeinschaft bildet, Unterauftragsverhältnisse oder Eignungsleihe erforderlich sind, sind Bewerbungsbogen und die „Eigenerklärung zur Eignung“ mehrfach (wie im Weiteren ausgeführt) auszufüllen. Bewerber­/Bietergemeinschaften: Bewerbergemeinschaften haben jeweils die Mitglieder sowie eines ihrer Mitglieder als bevollmächtigten Vertreter für den Abschluss der Durchführung des Vertrages zu benennen. Es erfolgt eine vergleichende Bewertung der von den Bewerbern MPG_IGP-P-2025-0001 30.07.2026 10:01 Seite 21 von 22 dargestellten Referenzen in ihrer Gesamtheit mit 0 bis 4 Punkten. Folgende Kriterien/Anforderungen dienen als Grundlage der Bewertung einer Referenz (Refe- renzaspekte): • Vergleichbarkeit der vom Bewerber im Rahmen des Referenzprojekts erbrachten mit den hier ausgeschriebenen Leistungen, • Vergleichbarkeit des Auftragsvolumens (Auftragswert und zeitlicher Umfang) zu dem hier ausgeschriebenen Auftrag, • Vollständigkeit, Aussagekraft und Stimmigkeit (Widerspruchsfreiheit) der Darstellung. Anhand der folgenden Wertungsaspekte wird die Qualifikation der Agentur beurteilt: Los 1 (EK-12-Ba bis EK-12-Bg): a. Durch Referenzen belegte Expertise der Agentur mit internationaler Wissenschafts- pressearbeit, auch für große internationale Forschungsprojekte. b. award_criteria.text: zwingend vollständig auszufüllenden Tabellen zur Prüfung dieses Aspektes der Eignung ausreichend. Eine Referenz wird grundsätzlich als vergleichbar bewertet, wenn sie sämtliche Mindestanforderungen in einem einheitlichen Projekt erfüllt und die entsprechenden Leistungen ab 2019 erbracht wurden. Generell unzulässig ist es, die in unterschiedlichen Projekten erbrachten Leistungen zu einer „vergleichbaren Leistung“ zusammenzufassen oder einheitliche Projekte aufzuteilen. CVP IS – Centrinė viešųjų pirkimų informacinė sistema, adresu https://viesiejipirkimai.lt. Dalyvis – pasiūlymą pateikęs tiekėjas. EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, ak

tytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar kelių perkančiųjų organizacijų ir vieno ar kelių tiekėjų sudaryta sutartis, kurios tikslas – nustatyti sąlygas, įskaitant kainą ir, kur to reikia, numatomą kiekį, taikomas viešojo pirkimo–pardavimo sutartims, kurios bus sudarytos per tam tikrą nurodytą laikotarpį. PVM – pridėtinės vertės mokestis. Reglamentas - Tarybos reglamentas (ES) 2022/576 2022 m. balandžio 8 d. kuriuo iš dalies keičiamas Reglamentas (ES) Nr. 833/2014 dėl ribojamųjų priemonių atsižvelgiant į Rusijos veiksmus, kuriais destabilizuojama padėtis Ukrainoje. Skelbimas – skelbimas apie pirkimą. Subtiekėjas – subtiekėjas, subteikėjas, subrangovas, fizinis ar juridinis asmuo, kuris faktiškai vykdys numatomą sudaryti sutartį ar jos dalį ir kurio kvalifikacija tiekėjas

eikalavimus. Subtiekėjais nelaikomi fiziniai ir juridiniai asmenys, kurie tik vykdo sutartines prievoles tiekėjui, tačiau faktiškai nevykdys numatomos sudaryti sutarties ar jos dalies. Sutartis – viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis ar preliminarioji sutartis, kaip nustatyta 1.8 punkte, kai viešojo pirkimo sutarčiai ir preliminariajai sutarčiai VPĮ nustatytas vienodas reglamentavimas. Tiekėjas – ūkio subjektas – fizinis asmuo, privatusis ar viešasis juridinis asmuo, kita organizacija ir jų struktūrinis padalinys arba tokių asmenų grupė, įskaitant laikinas ūkio subjektų asociacijas, kurie rinkoje siūlo atlikti darbus, tiekti prekes ar teikti paslaugas. Ūkio subjektas, kurio pajėgumais remiamasi – fizinis ar juridinis asmuo, kurio pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį, kad atitiktų kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. Ūkio subjektais, kurių pajėgumais remiamasi, nelaikomi fiziniai ir juridiniai asmenys, kurie tik vykdo sutartines prievoles tiekėjui, tačiau tiekėjas nesiremia jų pajėgumais pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį, kad atitiktų perkančiosios organizacijos keliamus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. VPĮ – Lietuvos Respublikos viešųjų pirkimų įstatymas. Kvazisubtiekėjas – specialistas, kurio kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi, ir kuris pasiūlymo teikimo metu dar nėra tiekėjo, ūkio subjekto, kur

punkte nurodytą statusą. Tiekėjas turi pagrįsti, kad jis, ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais remiasi ir (ar) pasitelkiami subtiekėjai turi 8.2 punkte nurodytą statusą, pateikdamas kompetentingos institucijos išduotą dokumentą ar tiekėjo patvirtintą deklaraciją. Tiekėjas, ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi, ir pasitelkiami subtiekėjai visą dalyvavimo pirkime ir sutarties vykdymo laikotarpį privalo išlaikyti 8.2 punkte nurodytą statusą. Jeigu perkančioji organizacija rezervuoja teisę pirkime dalyvauti tik VPĮ 24 straipsnyje nurodytiems tiekėjams, pirkime gali dalyvauti tik įmonės, atitinkančios visus šiuos reikalavimus: jos tikslas turi būti viešosios paslaugos, susijusios su sveikatos, socialinėmis, kultūros paslaugomis, kurių BVPŽ kodai yra 75121000-0, 75122000-7, 75123000-4, 79622000-0, 79624000-4, 79625000-1, 80110000-8, 80300000-7, 80420000-4, 80430000-7, 80511000-9, 80520000-5, 80590000-6, nuo 85000000-9 iki 85323000-9, 92500000-6, 92600000-7, 98133000-4, 98133110-8, teikimas; jos pelnas gali būti panaudojamas tik įmonės veiklos tikslams. Les échanges courants durant la procédure de passation (questions/réponses, lettres de rejet, notification, etc…) sont effectués en utilisant ce profil d’acheteur. Le profil d’acheteur garantit la sécurité, la confidentialité, l’intégrité et la traçabilité des échanges. Afin de permettre à un opérateur économique de déposer une offre , la plateforme www.xmarches.fr oblige l’identification. Un représentant de l’opérateur économique doit préalablement avoir créé un compte sur la plateforme et l’avoir activé (se référer au guide utilisateur Entreprise). Les informations nécessaires à la création de de compte sont : Les coordonnées générales de l’opérateur économique ainsi que les coordonnées personnelles de la personne agissant pour le compte de l’opérateur économique. La création du compte est uniquement réalisée après validation d u

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Pricing shall be for access to a single government account by extended members of the team which includes a mix of government personnel and contractor teams. BACKGROUND The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Troop Support - Philadelphia Medical Customer Operations and Supplier Operations combine to perform world-wide medical supply chain management for DoD medical materiel and supplies directly supporting warfighters

wide medical supply chain management for DoD medical materiel and supplies directly supporting warfighters in theatre and their families at home. Information Operations (J6) develops and sustains the Medical Logistics (MedLog) suite of Information Technology (IT) applications, which includes the Defense Medical Logistics Standard Support – Wholesale (DMLSS-W) program, that enable all dimensions of Defense Medical Logistics operations and support. With the emerging adoption of standards and the recent move by manufacturers to meet U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) requirements, DMLSS-W is seeking to take advantage of the growing availability of standardized product data in the supply chain. The government is seeking a solution that will provide available data for comparison and possible incorporation into our supply chain systems. 2. SCOPE This Statement of Work outlines the requirements for a medical/surgical product data subscription to improve data quality (accurate, current, and standardized data) in the DMLSS -W medical master item system. It is not intended to acquire IT services, technical and management expertise that support applications, software, hardware, infrastructure or any system in the DLA IT enterprise. 3. The Hospital is a voluntary public hospital, operating under its own Charter pursuant to the Dublin Eye and Ear Hospital Act, 1897, and is publicly funded through the Health Service Executive (“HSE”). RVEEH forms part of the public hospital system and operates in alignment with HSE governance, financial and regulatory requirements. The Hospital has been in continuous operation on its current site since 1904, following its establishment through the amalgamation of earlier specialist eye and ear institutions in the late nineteenth century. With over 120 years of continuous service deli very, RVEEH occupies a unique position within the Irish health system as the sole hospital dedicated exclusively to ophthalmology and ENT care. RVEEH provides specialist inpatient, day -case, outpatient and emergency services for adults and children, and acts as the national referral centre for complex and highly specialised ophthalmic and ENT conditions. deliverables_scope.text: ientemente documentados para permitir um entendimento funcional por parte dos técnicos da Entidade Adjudicante. O sistema deve permitir a possibilidade de exportação pelo utilizador (sem necessitar de intervenção da adjudicada) de quaisquer dados ou resultados. Essa disponibilização deverá ser feita em formatos comuns como .XLS (Excel) ou shapefile e sem implicar dependências futuras para uso. A funcionalidade de exportação deve ser configurável por perfil de acesso O fornecedor deve reconhecer a propriedade dos dados e resultados gerados como sendo da Entidade Adjudicante. O número de utilizadores deverá ser ilimitado, bem como o volume de dados gerados e o número de sensores a considerar. 1.1. Características/funcionalidades obrigatórias do serviço 1.1.1. O modelo de serviço a disponibilizar será um software baseado na web, com alojamento num servidor cloud seguro gerido pelo fornecedor e acedido pelos utilizadores através da Internet, sem necessidade de configuração no computador do utilizador. 1.1.2. O número de utilizadores que acedem ao software será ilimitado, podendo ser acedido por diferentes utilizadores ao mesmo tempo. 1.1.3. A segurança do armazenamento de dados deve ser feita em servidores dedicados do fornecedor, com intuito de proteger a sua priv

disponíveis, e capacidade de validação dos eventos de monitorização por cruzamento com as OT e com atualizações do Sistema de Informação Geográfica (SIG). 2.1.3. Flexibilidade na definição de subsistemas e ZMC, através da combinação de medidores de qualquer tipo, incluindo de telemetria domiciliária e grandes consumidores, e capacidade de medição e de integração de diferentes sistemas de monitorização. 2.2. Medidores 2.2.1. Possibilitar um registo das ações realizadas pelas equipas operacionais que permita o acompanhamento do ciclo de vida do evento, desde a sua deteção até à resolução. 2.2.2. Obtenção de uma estimativa fiável do volume de água perdida nos eventos detetados pelo subsistema e ZMC respetiva. 2.2.3. Capacidade de monitorizar e detetar eventos em dados de caudal, pressão, nível, parâmetros de qualidade da água e qualquer outra grandeza monitorizada pela Entidade Adjudicante. 2.2.4. Importação de dados de faturação e/ou de telemetria, com análise comparativa em contínuo de totais abastecidos e faturados por zona, para qualquer período. 2.2.5. Capacidade de análise estatística dos valores medidos por cada medidor individualmente para avaliação da qualidade e fiabilidade da medição e para identificação de problemas de sobredimensionamento ou inadequação ao

rmas padronizadas da IWA e da ERSAR, com possibilidade de alteração ou edição das parcelas do Balanço Hídrico pela Entidade Adjudicante. 3.2. - Indicadores de perdas 3.2.1. Cálculo automático por zona e por subsistema, para qualquer período de tempo, dos indicadores de perdas definidos pela Entidade Adjudicante, incluindo os indicadores consagrados pela ERSAR e pela IWA. 3.3. Gestão de contadores e estimativa de erros de micro-medição 3.3.1. Integração de informação relativa ao cadastro de contadores e suas características e de dados de leitura de cada contador (consumos de água). 3.3.2. Estimativa de erros globais de medição e do volume de perdas de faturação devido a submedição, por contador e para um conjunto de contadores. 3.3.3. Análise de consumos e dos resultados dos indicadores para o total de contadores, por subconjuntos ou para apenas um contador. 3.3.4. Análise comparativa dos valores de consumos de água e de erros de medição em períodos homólogos. 3.3.5. Análise da distribuição de consumos médios mensais por diâmetro e por intervalos de idade. 3.3.6. Geração de alertas para contadores a renovar, potencialmente parados, com problemas de dimensionamento e/ou com consumos anómalos (que podem indicar usos não autorizados). 3.3.7. Cálculo de indicadores,

dicadores, variáveis e estatísticas por contador, subconjuntos ou total de contadores e sua associação às respetivas zonas de medição e controlo. 3.3.8. Geração de alertas para aspetos relativos à fiabilidade dos dados de cadastro dos contadores. 3.3.9. Suporte à elaboração de planos de substituição de contadores, com base numa análise financeira e através de planos personalizáveis pelo utilizador com base em critérios económicos, de erros e/ou das idades dos contadores. 3.3.10. Os planos de substituição devem ser exportáveis para excel, contendo a lista de contadores a substituir, bem como o investimento associado, a recuperação de volume, o período de retorno do investimento e o erro expectável com a substituição dos contadores do plano. 3.3.11. Visualização em mapa de indicadores por contador ou por ZMC. 3.3.12. Visualização em mapa da distribuição dos consumos médios mensais e das idades por contador ou por ZMC. We believe that the present requirements restrict competition and do not align with the principles of fair, open, and non-discriminatory tendering procedures. We therefore kindly request that the specifications be reviewed and revised to adopt more generic requirements. Faciliter le vote pour les personnels et/ou usagers en mission ou en déplacement, 3°. Obtenir en fin de scrutin des résultats sécurisés et affichés en quelques minutes, 4°. Modalités du scrutin électronique Un scrutin est défini comme une opération de vote permettant d’élire les représentants d’un même collège électoral au sein d’une même instance. L'ensemble des électeurs à un scrutin est rattaché à un seul bureau de vote. Lorsque plusieurs scrutins ont lieu en même temps, un bureau de vote centralisateur peut être créé.

This process will be split into two stages: 1. Pre-qualification Questionnaire (PQQ, as described in this document) – The main objectives of this stage would be to understand supplier capabilities, experience and financial standing in order to shortlist suppliers for the Invitation to Tender (ITT). 2. Invitation to Tender (ITT) – Suppliers shortlisted following the PQQ will receive an Invitation to Tender (ITT). Please note that the ITT will be a separate document and is not part of this PQQ document. Tenderers that are shortlisted as a result of the first stage might be required to carry out a site visit at ECMWF premises as part of the tender process (the building will still be under construction). Tenderers who are not shortlisted for stage two will not be considered further for this tender. 1.3. Background to ECMWF and services ECMWF is an independent inter

penditure under the Framework. It does not constitute a commitment or guarantee of any minimum or maximum volume, value or number of future orders. Inclusion on the Framework does not confer any entitlement to receive future business, and any purchases made under the Framework will be subject to ECMWF’s operational requirements, available funding and the procedures described in this ITT. 2.5. Evaluation Criteria and Award Methodology for Framework Admission and Initial Purchase (Lot 1) Tenders will be evaluated based on the evaluation criteria and weights shown in the table below. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Confluence aplinkoje naudojami šie įskiepiai: ScriptRunner; BPMN Modeler Enterprise; MiniOrange SAML for Confluence. Dauguma naudojamų įskiepių licencijuoti pagal akademines Atlassian Data Center licencijas iki 500 naudotojų. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2 όπου εφαρμόζεται) Το Πανεπιστήμιο Κύπρου επιθυμεί να εφαρμόσει ένα σύστημα NAC για τη διαχείριση της πρόσβασης χρηστών και συσκευών στο ενσύρματο και ασύρματο δίκτυο του Πανεπιστημίου. Η λύση θα επιτρέπει την εφαρμογή πολιτικής zero-trust, τη συνεχή ταυτοποίηση χρηστών και συσκευών, την απομόνωση μη ασφαλών ή μη αναγνωρισμένων συσκευών και τη διαχείριση των συσκευών IoT, BYOD και guest στο Πανεπιστημιακό δίκτυο. Ο Ανάδοχος οφείλει να προμηθεύσει, εγκαταστήσει, παραμετροποιήσει και υποστηρίξει το σύστημα NAC σύμφωνα με τις ελάχιστες τεχνικές προδιαγραφές, όπως περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 των εγγράφων του Διαγωνισμού. Όλες οι απαιτ

που αποκτούν πρόσβαση στο ενσύρματο και ασύρματο δίκτυο, Asset inventory όλων των συνδεδεμένων συσκευών σε πραγματικό χρόνο καθώς και αναγνώριση και κατηγοριοποίηση IoT, BYOD, guest και άλλων συσκευών, Εφαρμογή πολιτικής zero trust στο εσωτερικό δίκτυο. Καθορισμός κατάλληλων δικτυακών προσβάσεων ανάλογα με χρήστη, ρόλο (Staff, Student, Guest κτλ.) και είδος συσκευής, Έλεγχος για συμμόρφωση με πολιτικές ασφάλειας π.χ. μη ύπαρξη updated λειτουργικού OS, εφαρμογής antivirus (σε συγκεκριμένα endpoints) Βελτίωση της ικανότητας γρήγορης ανίχνευσης και αποτελεσματικής ανταπόκρισης σε περιστατικά ασφάλειας, Συμμόρφωση με τις απαιτήσεις του προτύπου ISO 27001:2022 της ευρωπαϊκής οδηγίας NIS2, καθώς και με άλλα σύγχρονα κανονιστικά και κατευθυντήρια πλαίσια ασφάλειας πληροφοριών. Ανάλυση Απαιτήσεων – Προδιαγραφές Περιγραφή Απαιτήσεων Ο Διαγωνισμός αφορά την προμήθεια και υλοποίηση λύσης Network Access Control (NAC) με στόχο την ενίσχυση της ασφάλειας του δικτύου και τον αποτελεσματικό έλεγχο πρόσβασης χρηστών και συσκευών στις υποδομές του Πανεπιστημίου. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει μηχανισμούς ταυτοποίησης και εξουσιοδότησης για ενσύρματη και ασύρματη πρόσβαση, να υποστηρίζει πρότυπα όπως 802.1X, καθώς και δυνατότητες δυναμικής εφαρμογής πολιτικών ασφαλείας βάσει ρόλων, τύπου συσκευής ή επιπέδου

Účastník zadávacího řízení je srozuměn s tím, že veškeré písemnosti zasílané prostřednictvím elektronického nástroje se považují za řádně doručené dnem jejich doručení do uživatelského účtu adresáta v elektronickém nástroji. Účastník přijímá, že na doručen í písemností nemá vliv, zda byla písemnost jejím adresátem přečtena, případně, zda elektronický nástroj adresátovi odeslal na kontaktní emailovou adresu upozornění o jejím doručení či nikoli. Za řádné a včasné seznamování se s písemnostmi zasílanými zadavatelem prostřednictvím elektronického nástroje, jakož i za správnost kontaktních údajů uvedených u dodavatele, odpovídá vždy dodavatel. 3. Uveřejněný dokument se stáhne klikem na přiřazenou ikonu nebo na jeho název. Při stažení dokumentu registrovaným dodavatelem, sledujícím veřejnou zakázku, získá zadavatel kontaktní informace o dodavateli, který dokument stáhl a tím se dodavatel stává pro zadavatele známým, ve smyslu poskytování doplňujících informací k ZD. rat takovýto certifikát od akreditovaného poskytovatele Certifikační autority, např. Česká pošta, s.p., eldentity, a.s., První certifikační autorita, a.s. UPOZORNĚNÍ: V případě, že zadavatel nepožaduje el. nabídku podepsanou kvalifikovaným certifikátem, není potřeba aby si ho dodavatel obstarával. S konkrétními dotazy ohledně podání nabídky v rámci zadávacího řízení, se prosím obracejte na zadavatele předmětného zadávacího / výběrového řízení. Do přílohy se vloží soubor (Nabídka) a následně se stiskne tlačítko "Pokračovat". Podepsání nabídky: a) podání nabídky bez nutnosti elektronického podepsání se dokončí stisknutím tlačítka "ODESLAT". Dodavatel však může zvolit i podání nabídky s opatřením elektronického podpisu. (Požadavky na nabídku zadavatel stanoví v Zadávací dokumentaci předmětného zadávacího či výběrového řízení !). b) podání nabídky s povinností elektronického podepsání se spustí stisknutím tlačitka "PODEPSAT A ODESLAT" (Požadavky na nabídku zadavatel stanoví v Zadávací dokumentaci předmětného zadávacího či výběrového řízení !). Pokud aplikace pro podepsání nabídky není ještě instalování v PC zařízení, zobrazí se tato informace a je potřeba provést prvotní instalaci aplikace. Více viz. kapitola 2.5.5 Pokud je již aplikace pro podepsání nabídky instalování

Rationale for Use of Authority (RFO 6.104-1(a)(5)): GDMS is the only company able to supply this training as they are the designer, developer, and manufacturer of the TACLANE systems. As a result, their direct product knowledge, understanding of the hardware, software, and underlying cryptographic algorithms, and comprehensive portfolio coverage makes them the one company that can ensure proper training is administered. TACLANE products are all certified to protect national security, and GDMS understands the strict, legally mandated operational requirements associated with handling and managing High Assurance Cryptographic Equipment. Additionally, their training is strictly regulated and compliant with international military standards. ons. II – GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARTICLE II.1 – PERFORMANCE OF THE CONTRACT The Contractor shall perform the contract in good faith and to the highest professional standards. The Contractor must comply with applicable legal obligations, in particular under environmental, social and labour law, as established by European Union law, national law and collective agreements or by the international social and environmental conventions listed in Annex X to Directive 2014/24/EU (OJ L 94, 28.3.2014, p. 65), and also under tax and data protection law. The Contractor shall be responsible for obtaining, in good time, all permits, authorisations, accreditations or licences needed to perform the contract. Should any event hamper or risk hampering the performance of the contract, the Contractor must immediately and on its own initiative record it and report it to the European Parliament. The report must describe the problem, indicate the date on which it arose and detail the steps taken by the Contractor to ensure compliance with all its contractual obligations. In such an event and unless otherwise instructed, the Contractor undertakes to give priority to the steps to be taken to ensure compliance with its contractual obligations rather than to determining who is responsible. On average, 3 -4 companies headquartered on the US West Coast invest in Ireland every month between 2024 and 2025. San Francisco Bay Area Investment in Ireland San Francisco Bay Area companies have a particularly strong presence in Ireland, with major operations from companies including Airbnb, Alphabet/Google, Applied Materials, Autodesk, Cadence, Cisco, DocuSign , Dropbox, eBay, Fidelity, Fitbit, Gilead, GoFundMe, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Indeed, Intel, LinkedIn, Meta (Facebook), Oracle, PayPal, Salesforce, Slack, Stripe, Twilio, Uber, Udemy, Broadcom, Wells Fargo, Workday and Zendesk. For many of these compani es, Ireland serves as their European headquarters. 3.2 Core Requirements IDA Ireland is seeking the services of a US PR Agency based on the West Coast of America, to help position Ireland as the leading European location for global companies looking to establish or grow their business internationally. The core focus of the contracted work would be media relations , ensuring that IDA Ireland’s brand and Ireland's business proposition generally, achieves a prominent presence across West Coast media print and digital channels. The

sla_onsite.text: will be on positioning within the technology sector, as well as life sciences (medical technologies and biopharma), financial services and others. IDA Ireland is keen to partner with an agency that can provide occasional media exposure/coverage beyond the Bay Area and along the West Coast in places such as Portland, Utah and Seattle. IDA Ireland will seek support from its pr agency to leverage speaking opportunities and deliver media outreach activity around key sectoral/trade events as well as providing media outreach support for visiting IDA Ireland Executives and government Ministers. It is important that the pr agency team can be on site to support IDA Ireland at these events and media engagements. The target audience for these communication activities are C -suite executives (leading decision makers) primarily at leading tech and life sciences firms across the West Coast as well as those leading 17 | P a g e fast-growth emerging companies, many of which come from the unique `Valley’ ecosystem and general Bay Area. For this reason it is a requirement that tenderers must have at least one reference client from the Technology Sector. etitive Contract Action Justification Intended Source: CACI Federal, Inc. 14370 Newbrook Drive Chantilly, VA 20151-4206 Justification and Lack of Competition: PAE MS / Marine Corps Systems Command intends to execute a sole-source modification to extend the ordering period by up to three years (ending 25 December 2029, or upon successful operational cut-over, whichever occurs first) and increase the contract ceiling by $150,000,000.00. The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1, "Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements." Competition is lacking because this transitional phase requires highly specialized systems integration, database engineering, and business process reengineering (BPR) services that cannot be unbundled from the active operational sustainment of the legacy GCSS-MC environment. Over its lifecycle, the legacy GCSS-MC E-Business Suite (EBS) architecture has undergone non-standard, extensive customization, resulting in a tightly coupled, bespoke data schema that deviates from commercial baselines. The incumbent systems integrator possesses exclusive institutional knowledge of these system-specific idiosyncrasies, ongoing API integrations, and no

se system-specific idiosyncrasies, ongoing API integrations, and non-standard data tables. Onboarding a new vendor to perform these critical services during the sunset window of the legacy platform would inject unacceptable schedule delays (estimated at 12 to 18 months) to account for procurement lead time, contractor transition, and reverse-engineering of the legacy codebase. Under RFO 6.103-1(c)(2)(ii), such delays would directly compromise total unit readiness across the operating forces, degrade the entire GCSS-MC logistics enterprise, and disrupt the transition to the future Logistics Chain Management System (LCMS). (viii) Qualification Requirements There are no pre-established, formal qualification requirements (per RFO Part 9) that an offeror or its service must meet to be eligible for award. However, any interested source must demonstrate immediate, expert-level capability to sustain the highly customized GCSS-MC EBS environment and execute complex database cleansing and extraction without causing operational downtime. Three values can be chosen; ‘Disabled’, Optional’ or ‘Mandatory’. If the parameter is set to ‘Mandatory’, the user must request master control mode before being able to change configuration parameters. 3.12.4 Secure protocol Parameter Control Data protocols newer than v. 2.0 and all TRACK Control Data protocols can be secured by a certificate. For each of these protocols, the user may specify whether the protocol should be secured by the certificate, by enabling “Secure Protocol Extensions”. These extensions provide encrypted, authenticated wrappers of the corresponding protocols of the SCANTER Transceiver. Encryption and authentication are based on industry-standard X.509 client/server certificates and TLS version 1.2. 3.12.5 User authentication The Transceiver Control Interface protocol supports Secure Protocol Extensions for encrypted, authenticated access, which means that no third party can gain access without the suitable certificate, which is generated and uploaded via RST. • The Radar Service Tool is a software package, which connects to the Transceiver(s) via an IP network connection. For each rota- tion the encoder sends a number of azimuth count pulses (ACPs), typically 8192 pulses and one azimuth reference pulse (ARP). The encoder is included in a encoder assembly which nor- mally holds one or two encoders. Extractor The extractor analyzes the incoming video for plot cre- ation. Furthermore, it calculates plot properties such as area, intensity, centre of gravity etc. Frequency diversity Frequency diversity (FD) is a sequential transmission on two different frequencies which after processing increas- es the signal quality by an increase of the signal-to-noise ratio. The target is hit twice and behaves differently depending upon the frequency of the electromagnetic wave hitting it. Furthermore, if linear array antennas are used, an additional advantage is achieved, namely the time diversity. Lack Lack is a number counting unsuccessful consecutive updates of a track. Log Compression In this process, the signal is converted from a 26 bit float- ing point signal into an 8-bit logarithmic signal. Mixer A function of the mixer is to convert frequencies, either up or down. The ideal mixer performs the mathematical mul- tiplication of two input signals. It creates signal compo- nents positioned at frequencies equal to the sum and difference of the input signals. For ideal performance, the mixing device must be perfect- ly linear and there must be no leakage of the input signals to the output port. Typically, either the sum, or the differ- ence frequency is removed with a filter. The term Double Balanced Mixer is used to imply neither of the input terms will appear at the mixer output. Sofern ein Unternehmen den Auftrag nicht alleine ausführen kann, d. h. eine Bewerber­/Bietergemeinschaft bildet, Unterauftragsverhältnisse oder Eignungsleihe erforderlich sind, sind Bewerbungsbogen und die „Eigenerklärung zur Eignung“ mehrfach (wie im Weiteren ausgeführt) auszufüllen. Bewerber­/Bietergemeinschaften: Bewerbergemeinschaften haben jeweils die Mitglieder sowie eines ihrer Mitglieder als bevollmächtigten Vertreter für den Abschluss der Durchführung des Vertrages zu benennen. Dies erfolgt durch die Abgabe der im Bewerbungsbogen verlangten Angaben. Nimmt der Wirtschaftsteilnehmer gemeinsam mit anderen am Vergabeverfahren teil, trägt dieser dafür Sorge, dass die sonstigen Beteiligten einen separaten Bewerbungsbogen und die „Eigenerklärung zur Eignung“ vorlegen. Nachunternehmer (Unterauftragnehmer mit Eignungsleihe): Bei Unterauftragnehmern mit Eignungsleihe sind pro Unternehmen ein separater Bewerbungsbogen und die „Eigenerklärung zur Eignung“ einzureichen. Nachunternehmer (Unterauftragnehmer ohne Eignungsleihe): Wenn das beteiligte Unternehmen einen Nachunternehmer/Unterauftragnehmer ohne Eignungsleihe einsetzen will, ist pro Unternehmen die „Eigenerklärung zur Eignung“ einzureichen. S. d. §§ 123 oder 12 4 GWB. Hierzu hat der Bewerber unter Verwendung der Anlage 5 Abschnitt „Nichtvorliegen von Ausschlussgründen“ zu erklären, dass keiner der dort genannten Ausschlussgründe vorliegt. Die Erklärung ist zwingend von jedem Unternehmen einzureichen (vgl. bei bloßem Unter- auftragnehmer allerdings Kapitel 2). 3.2.2 Angaben zum Wirtschaftsteilnehmer und Befähigung zur Berufsaus- übung Die in diesem Kapitel geforderten Angaben und Nachweise sind zwingend von jedem Unter- nehmen (außer einem bloßen Unterauftragnehmer) einzureichen. 3.2.2.1 Unternehmensdarstellung (EK-02-A) Verlangt werden folgende Angaben zum Wirtschaftsteilnehmer: • Name des Unternehmens (Firma), Anschrift, USt-ID-Nummer, Gründungsjahr, Telefon, E-Mail, ggf. Fax, ggf. Internetadresse, • Angaben zur Unternehmensgröße (Vorliegen eines Kleinstunternehmens, eines kleinen Unternehmens oder eines mittleren Unternehmens i. entity_geography.text: NUMBER Section A - Solicitation/Contract Form TW125 Iwakuni APDU System Maintenance Product Service Code: J017 Solicitation Information All quotes/responses shall be submitted via email to Maria Sproul at maria.a.sproul.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time on 27 August 2026. Solicitation N0042126Q1329 is issued as a Intent to Sole Source. The Government intends to purchase on a firm fixed-price basis, and to solicit and negotiate the proposed purchase order on a sole source basis with NTT Data Japan Corporation for Hardware and Software Maintenance Support as list under the authority of FAR 13.501. Offerors must be registered in SAM.GOV database prior to submission of an offer to be considered for award of any DoD contract. This may be accomplished electronically at https://sam.gov This is a firm fixed price procurement therefore, the offeror's initial offer should represent vendor's best quote in terms of price and technical acceptability. This notice is intent to Sole Source with NTT Data Japan Corporation which is a Large Business. Vendors must be NTT Data Japan Corporation authorized distributor and provide documentation to be considered. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes. However, the Government will consider all quotes received.

CVP IS – Centrinė viešųjų pirkimų informacinė sistema, adresu https://viesiejipirkimai.lt. Dalyvis – pasiūlymą pateikęs tiekėjas. EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, ak

tytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Preliminarioji sutartis – preliminarioji viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis (jei taikoma), vienos ar kelių perkančiųjų organizacijų ir vieno ar kelių tiekėjų sudaryta sutartis, kurios tikslas – nustatyti sąlygas, įskaitant kainą ir, kur to reikia, numatomą kiekį, taikomas viešojo pirkimo–pardavimo sutartims, kurios bus sudarytos per tam tikrą nurodytą laikotarpį. PVM – pridėtinės vertės mokestis. Reglamentas - Tarybos reglamentas (ES) 2022/576 2022 m. balandžio 8 d. kuriuo iš dalies keičiamas Reglamentas (ES) Nr. 833/2014 dėl ribojamųjų priemonių atsižvelgiant į Rusijos veiksmus, kuriais destabilizuojama padėtis Ukrainoje. Skelbimas – skelbimas apie pirkimą. Subtiekėjas – subtiekėjas, subteikėjas, subrangovas, fizinis ar juridinis asmuo, kuris faktiškai vykdys numatomą sudaryti sutartį ar jos dalį ir kurio kvalifikacija tiekėjas

eikalavimus. Subtiekėjais nelaikomi fiziniai ir juridiniai asmenys, kurie tik vykdo sutartines prievoles tiekėjui, tačiau faktiškai nevykdys numatomos sudaryti sutarties ar jos dalies. Sutartis – viešojo pirkimo-pardavimo sutartis ar preliminarioji sutartis, kaip nustatyta 1.8 punkte, kai viešojo pirkimo sutarčiai ir preliminariajai sutarčiai VPĮ nustatytas vienodas reglamentavimas. Tiekėjas – ūkio subjektas – fizinis asmuo, privatusis ar viešasis juridinis asmuo, kita organizacija ir jų struktūrinis padalinys arba tokių asmenų grupė, įskaitant laikinas ūkio subjektų asociacijas, kurie rinkoje siūlo atlikti darbus, tiekti prekes ar teikti paslaugas. Ūkio subjektas, kurio pajėgumais remiamasi – fizinis ar juridinis asmuo, kurio pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį, kad atitiktų kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. Ūkio subjektais, kurių pajėgumais remiamasi, nelaikomi fiziniai ir juridiniai asmenys, kurie tik vykdo sutartines prievoles tiekėjui, tačiau tiekėjas nesiremia jų pajėgumais pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį, kad atitiktų perkančiosios organizacijos keliamus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. VPĮ – Lietuvos Respublikos viešųjų pirkimų įstatymas. Kvazisubtiekėjas – specialistas, kurio kvalifikacija tiekėjas remiasi, ir kuris pasiūlymo teikimo metu dar nėra tiekėjo, ūkio subjekto, kur

punkte nurodytą statusą. Tiekėjas turi pagrįsti, kad jis, ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais remiasi ir (ar) pasitelkiami subtiekėjai turi 8.2 punkte nurodytą statusą, pateikdamas kompetentingos institucijos išduotą dokumentą ar tiekėjo patvirtintą deklaraciją. Tiekėjas, ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais tiekėjas remiasi, ir pasitelkiami subtiekėjai visą dalyvavimo pirkime ir sutarties vykdymo laikotarpį privalo išlaikyti 8.2 punkte nurodytą statusą. Jeigu perkančioji organizacija rezervuoja teisę pirkime dalyvauti tik VPĮ 24 straipsnyje nurodytiems tiekėjams, pirkime gali dalyvauti tik įmonės, atitinkančios visus šiuos reikalavimus: jos tikslas turi būti viešosios paslaugos, susijusios su sveikatos, socialinėmis, kultūros paslaugomis, kurių BVPŽ kodai yra 75121000-0, 75122000-7, 75123000-4, 79622000-0, 79624000-4, 79625000-1, 80110000-8, 80300000-7, 80420000-4, 80430000-7, 80511000-9, 80520000-5, 80590000-6, nuo 85000000-9 iki 85323000-9, 92500000-6, 92600000-7, 98133000-4, 98133110-8, teikimas; jos pelnas gali būti panaudojamas tik įmonės veiklos tikslams. Les échanges courants durant la procédure de passation (questions/réponses, lettres de rejet, notification, etc…) sont effectués en utilisant ce profil d’acheteur. Le profil d’acheteur garantit la sécurité, la confidentialité, l’intégrité et la traçabilité des échanges. Afin de permettre à un opérateur économique de déposer une offre , la plateforme www.xmarches.fr oblige l’identification. Un représentant de l’opérateur économique doit préalablement avoir créé un compte sur la plateforme et l’avoir activé (se référer au guide utilisateur Entreprise). Les informations nécessaires à la création de de compte sont : Les coordonnées générales de l’opérateur économique ainsi que les coordonnées personnelles de la personne agissant pour le compte de l’opérateur économique. La création du compte est uniquement réalisée après validation d u

de sauvegarde transmise dans les délais impartis, sur support physique électronique ou sur support papier. Aucun format électronique n'est préconisé pour la transmission des documents. Cependant, les fichiers devront être transmis dans des formats largement disponibles. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. O sistema deve permitir a possibilidade de exportação pelo utilizador (sem necessitar de intervenção da adjudicada) de quaisquer dados ou resultados. Essa disponibilização deverá ser feita em formatos comuns como .XLS (Excel) ou shapefile e sem implicar dependências futuras para uso. A funcionalidade de exportação deve ser configurável por perfil de acesso O fornecedor deve reconhecer a propriedade dos dados e resultados gerados como sendo da Entidade Adjudicante. O número de utilizadores deverá ser ilimitado, bem como o volume de dados gerados e o número de sensores a considerar. 1.1. Características/funcionalidades obrigatórias do serviço 1.1.1. O modelo de serviço a disponibilizar será um software baseado na web, com alojamento num servidor cloud seguro gerido pelo fornecedor e acedido pelos utilizadores através da Internet, sem necessidade de configuração no computador do utilizador. 1.1.2. O número de utilizadores que acedem ao software será ilimitado, podendo ser acedido por diferentes utilizadores ao mesmo tempo. 1.1.3. A segurança do armazenamento de dados deve ser feita em servidores dedicados do fornecedor, com intuito de proteger a sua priv

disponíveis, e capacidade de validação dos eventos de monitorização por cruzamento com as OT e com atualizações do Sistema de Informação Geográfica (SIG). 2.1.3. Flexibilidade na definição de subsistemas e ZMC, através da combinação de medidores de qualquer tipo, incluindo de telemetria domiciliária e grandes consumidores, e capacidade de medição e de integração de diferentes sistemas de monitorização. 2.2. Medidores 2.2.1. Possibilitar um registo das ações realizadas pelas equipas operacionais que permita o acompanhamento do ciclo de vida do evento, desde a sua deteção até à resolução. 2.2.2. Obtenção de uma estimativa fiável do volume de água perdida nos eventos detetados pelo subsistema e ZMC respetiva. 2.2.3. Capacidade de monitorizar e detetar eventos em dados de caudal, pressão, nível, parâmetros de qualidade da água e qualquer outra grandeza monitorizada pela Entidade Adjudicante. 2.2.4. Importação de dados de faturação e/ou de telemetria, com análise comparativa em contínuo de totais abastecidos e faturados por zona, para qualquer período. 2.2.5. Capacidade de análise estatística dos valores medidos por cada medidor individualmente para avaliação da qualidade e fiabilidade da medição e para identificação de problemas de sobredimensionamento ou inadequação ao

rmas padronizadas da IWA e da ERSAR, com possibilidade de alteração ou edição das parcelas do Balanço Hídrico pela Entidade Adjudicante. 3.2. - Indicadores de perdas 3.2.1. Cálculo automático por zona e por subsistema, para qualquer período de tempo, dos indicadores de perdas definidos pela Entidade Adjudicante, incluindo os indicadores consagrados pela ERSAR e pela IWA. 3.3. Gestão de contadores e estimativa de erros de micro-medição 3.3.1. Integração de informação relativa ao cadastro de contadores e suas características e de dados de leitura de cada contador (consumos de água). 3.3.2. Estimativa de erros globais de medição e do volume de perdas de faturação devido a submedição, por contador e para um conjunto de contadores. 3.3.3. Análise de consumos e dos resultados dos indicadores para o total de contadores, por subconjuntos ou para apenas um contador. 3.3.4. Análise comparativa dos valores de consumos de água e de erros de medição em períodos homólogos. 3.3.5. Análise da distribuição de consumos médios mensais por diâmetro e por intervalos de idade. 3.3.6. Geração de alertas para contadores a renovar, potencialmente parados, com problemas de dimensionamento e/ou com consumos anómalos (que podem indicar usos não autorizados). 3.3.7. Cálculo de indicadores,

dicadores, variáveis e estatísticas por contador, subconjuntos ou total de contadores e sua associação às respetivas zonas de medição e controlo. 3.3.8. Geração de alertas para aspetos relativos à fiabilidade dos dados de cadastro dos contadores. 3.3.9. Suporte à elaboração de planos de substituição de contadores, com base numa análise financeira e através de planos personalizáveis pelo utilizador com base em critérios económicos, de erros e/ou das idades dos contadores. 3.3.10. Os planos de substituição devem ser exportáveis para excel, contendo a lista de contadores a substituir, bem como o investimento associado, a recuperação de volume, o período de retorno do investimento e o erro expectável com a substituição dos contadores do plano. 3.3.11. Visualização em mapa de indicadores por contador ou por ZMC. 3.3.12. Visualização em mapa da distribuição dos consumos médios mensais e das idades por contador ou por ZMC. Question1: With regard to Lot 2, Specification h, could you please indicate which type of barcode would be acceptable: a QR code or a Data Matrix barcode? Answer 1: Both barcode types are classified as 2D barcodes and are therefore acceptable under the specified specification (Item 2.1, point h). Any 2D barcode format will be considered acceptable, provided that all other tender specifications and requirements are met. All other documents, condition

tion. These specifications significantly limit the range of compliant solutions available on the market. We believe that the present requirements restrict competition and do not align with the principles of fair, open, and non-discriminatory tendering procedures. We therefore kindly request that the specifications be reviewed and revised to adopt more generic requirements. This would allow participation from a broader range of manufacturers and models while still ensuring that the contracting authority's operational needs are fully met. In addition, we would appreciate your consideration of a further extension to the submission deadline of a further two weeks, to allow sufficient time for economic operators to obtain and submit all the necessary technical information and documentation also in view of upcoming shutdown period where most suppliers close for holidays. Answer 1: The Contracting Authority already possesses a number of microscopes of varying age and capability. The purpose of Lot 2, Item 2.2 is to procure new microscopes that expand the laboratory's diagnostic capabilities by providing enhanced functionality for visual diagnostics and pathogen characterisation. While the technical specifications may potentially limit the range of microscope models that meet the required performance, they do not restrict participation to a single brand or model. The Contracting Authority confirms that the specifications for Lot 2, Item 2.2 will remain unchanged. No further extension to the submission deadline will be granted, as the procurement procedure is subject to statutory timeframes that must be adhered to. All other documents, conditions and requirements, which are not superseded by this Clarification, remain in place. Sectoral Procurement Directorate ===== FILE: files/18607_13908510_unpacked/12_60. De plus, la demande de modification des prix est appréciée au regard de l’équilibre financier de l’accord-cadre, et non pas au regard de la situation financière globale du cocontractant. Enfin, la mo dification envisagée doit se limiter à compenser les surcoûts réellement subis par le Titulaire du fait des évènements imprévisibles pour éviter de payer des sommes sans lien avec les circonstances. A défaut, il s’agirait d’un enrichissement sans cause au profit du Titulaire. L’Université exerce ses missions de service public de l’enseignement supérieur, de recherche et de diffusion des connaissances et contribue par ses actions aux objectifs ainsi assignés au service public. La mise en œuvre du vote électronique au sein de l’Université vise à : 1°. Simplifier et sécuriser l’organisation du processus électoral, 2°. Faciliter le vote pour les personnels et/ou usagers en mission ou en déplacement, 3°. Obtenir en fin de scrutin des résultats sécurisés et affichés en quelques minutes, 4°. Inscrire le processus électoral dans une démarche de préservation de l’environnement, 5°. Garantir la sécurité des opérations électorales et la confidentialité du vote. 5 CCTP 2026F002 IV. Modalités du scrutin électronique Un scrutin est défini comme une opération de vote permettant d’élire les représentants d’un même collège électoral au sein d’une même instance. L'ensemble des électeurs à un scrutin est rattaché à un seul bureau de vote. Lorsque plusieurs scrutins ont lieu en même temps, un bureau de vote centralisateur peut être créé.

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. The Veterans Administration Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 20 Sterile Processing Services (SPS) requires a solution to directly export load data from washer, disinfector and sterilizer systems to the Censis CensiTrac Instrument Tracking System (ITS). Currently, other VA Medical Centers within VISN 20 utilize Steris’s ConnectAssure for this purpose. This includes licensing and support services for 12 months and includes four one-year options for subscriptions required for continuation of the connectivity solution. This is a Brand Name or Equal (BNOE) to ConnectAssure with the required characteristics listed below. This solicitation is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ). The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular FAC 2026-02 effective March 13, 2026. ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2 όπου εφαρμόζεται) Το Πανεπιστήμιο Κύπρου επιθυμεί να εφαρμόσει ένα σύστημα NAC για τη διαχείριση της πρόσβασης χρηστών και συσκευών στο ενσύρματο και ασύρματο δίκτυο του Πανεπιστημίου. Η λύση θα επιτρέπει την εφαρμογή πολιτικής zero-trust, τη συνεχή ταυτοποίηση χρηστών και συσκευών, την απομόνωση μη ασφαλών ή μη αναγνωρισμένων συσκευών και τη διαχείριση των συσκευών IoT, BYOD και guest στο Πανεπιστημιακό δίκτυο. Ο Ανάδοχος οφείλει να προμηθεύσει, εγκαταστήσει, παραμετροποιήσει και υποστηρίξει το σύστημα NAC σύμφωνα με τις ελάχιστες τεχνικές προδιαγραφές, όπως περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 των εγγράφων του Διαγωνισμού. Όλες οι απαιτ

που αποκτούν πρόσβαση στο ενσύρματο και ασύρματο δίκτυο, Asset inventory όλων των συνδεδεμένων συσκευών σε πραγματικό χρόνο καθώς και αναγνώριση και κατηγοριοποίηση IoT, BYOD, guest και άλλων συσκευών, Εφαρμογή πολιτικής zero trust στο εσωτερικό δίκτυο. Καθορισμός κατάλληλων δικτυακών προσβάσεων ανάλογα με χρήστη, ρόλο (Staff, Student, Guest κτλ.) και είδος συσκευής, Έλεγχος για συμμόρφωση με πολιτικές ασφάλειας π.χ. μη ύπαρξη updated λειτουργικού OS, εφαρμογής antivirus (σε συγκεκριμένα endpoints) Βελτίωση της ικανότητας γρήγορης ανίχνευσης και αποτελεσματικής ανταπόκρισης σε περιστατικά ασφάλειας, Συμμόρφωση με τις απαιτήσεις του προτύπου ISO 27001:2022 της ευρωπαϊκής οδηγίας NIS2, καθώς και με άλλα σύγχρονα κανονιστικά και κατευθυντήρια πλαίσια ασφάλειας πληροφοριών. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει μηχανισμούς ταυτοποίησης και εξουσιοδότησης για ενσύρματη και ασύρματη πρόσβαση, να υποστηρίζει πρότυπα όπως 802.1X, καθώς και δυνατότητες δυναμικής εφαρμογής πολιτικών ασφαλείας βάσει ρόλων, τύπου συσκευής ή επιπέδου

Písemná komunikace mezi zadavatelem a dodavatelem musí probíhat elektronicky, a to prostřednictvím elektronického nástroje nebo e-mailové elektronické komunikace. Účastník zadávacího řízení je srozuměn s tím, že veškeré písemnosti zasílané prostřednictvím elektronického nástroje se považují za řádně doručené dnem jejich doručení do uživatelského účtu adresáta v elektronickém nástroji. Účastník přijímá, že na doručen í písemností nemá vliv, zda byla písemnost jejím adresátem přečtena, případně, zda elektronický nástroj adresátovi odeslal na kontaktní emailovou adresu upozornění o jejím doručení či nikoli. Za řádné a včasné seznamování se s písemnostmi zasílanými zadavatelem prostřednictvím elektronického nástroje, jakož i za správnost kontaktních údajů uvedených u dodavatele, odpovídá vždy dodavatel. 3. Dodavatel však může zvolit i podání nabídky s opatřením elektronického podpisu. (Požadavky na nabídku zadavatel stanoví v Zadávací dokumentaci předmětného zadávacího či výběrového řízení !). b) podání nabídky s povinností elektronického podepsání se spustí stisknutím tlačitka "PODEPSAT A ODESLAT" (Požadavky na nabídku zadavatel stanoví v Zadávací dokumentaci předmětného zadávacího či výběrového řízení !). Pokud aplikace pro podepsání nabídky není ještě instalování v PC zařízení, zobrazí se tato informace a je potřeba provést prvotní instalaci aplikace. Více viz. kapitola 2.5.5 Pokud je již aplikace pro podepsání nabídky instalování

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice.
